text:
Maya Chen: Quick design sync on the metrics dashboard charts — focusing on legend behavior, axis unit treatment, smoothing presets, and how we surface outliers. Short thread.
Jamal Ortiz: Saw the prototype. Legend looks crowded when there are 6+ series. Current collapse hides items behind a menu with no keyboard affordance.
Aisha Khan: Could we make the legend a two-line wrap when there's room and add a compact mode for dense charts? Also add a visible focus ring for keyboard users.
Elena Petrova: For units: we should default to compact SI (k/M) on axis ticks, but always show full unit in the hover tooltip and in aria-labels (e.g., "12.3k traces"). Avoid single-letter unit abbreviations like "t".
Sam Wu: Re: outliers: example dataset had a single 10x spike that squashed the rest. Options tested: linear clamp at 99th percentile, small-multiple inset, or separate y-axis for extreme values. My prototype uses a clipped main chart + inset mini-chart that shows full range.
Maya Chen: I like clipped main + inset. Would be nice if the clipped point has a marker with a tooltip "value clipped, click to show full range".
Jamal Ortiz: Important: when we clip at 99th percentile we should indicate it visually (dashed cap line) and include the actual clipped value in the tooltip. Don't silently hide data.
Elena Petrova: Smoothing: add two presets — "raw" and "trend (7-point)" — with the ability to custom set window size. Default to "raw" for alerts dashboards, but default to "trend" for overview dashboards.
Aisha Khan: Accessibility items: legend items must be reachable by Tab, Space or Enter toggles visibility, and the legend's hidden/visible state should be announced by screen readers. Also ensure color-blind safe palettes for series selection.
Design System Bot: Note: per token rules, legend text on gray-100 must be >= 4.5:1. Current teal on gray fails. Suggested replacement: teal -> #007A66 (contrast 4.8:1).
Sam Wu: Quick config snippet from prototype:
```
{
  "yUnit": "traces",
  "axisCompact": true,
  "unitDisplay": "compact-hover-full",
  "smoothingPreset": "raw",
  "outlierStrategy": "clip_99_inset",
  "legendMode": "wrap|compact-toggle",
  "keyboardLegend": true
}
```
Maya Chen: Copy tweaks: change tooltip label from "count" to "traces"; change legend toggle tooltip to "Toggle series visibility"; add aria-labels like "Legend: <series name>, visible".
Jamal Ortiz: UX nit: when series are hidden, reduce their line opacity to 0.12 instead of removing from DOM so hover/keyboard still can reference them. Also keep them in DOM order for screen readers.
Elena Petrova: For export/sync: smoothing should not alter exported CSV values. Exports must use raw underlying data. Add a warning banner if smoothing is enabled when exporting.
Maya Chen: Action list: Maya will update legend layout and color tokens; Aisha will write keyboard/aria spec; Sam will implement clip+inset and the clipped-marker tooltip; Jamal will adjust opacity behavior and export rules; Elena will write copy for tooltips and warnings. Reconvene Friday for review. :eyes:
Sam Wu: I'll also add unit tests for clip behavior and keyboard interactions.
Design System Bot: Preview build posted: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/legend-accessibility-1766 — test with VoiceOver/NVDA and check contrast.
Maya Chen: Thanks all, that covers it. Closing thread.
